# IndicBiz

> IndicBiz is an independent digital studio based in India, delivering brand identity, bespoke web development (React 19, Vite, Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, Lenis), UI/UX product design, and SEO/AEO growth systems to ambitious companies worldwide. Delivered directly by senior designers and engineers with no account-management middlemen.

## Key Facts

- Legal entity: IndicBiz Digital
- Location: India (operating as a globally distributed, remote-first studio)
- Global reach: Clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
- Core team: 7 senior specialists covering strategy, visual design, motion design, React engineering, and growth
- Engagement models: Transparent fixed-fee milestone projects and monthly retainers
- Core tech stack: React 19, Vite, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis, WebGL/Three.js
- Contact: info@indicbiz.com · +91 76590 42808 · https://indicbiz.com/contact

## Services

- [Brand Identity](https://indicbiz.com/services/brand-identity): Positioning, logo systems, kinetic motion marks, typography, color systems, and brand guideline books for companies launching or repositioning.
- [Web Experiences](https://indicbiz.com/services/web-experiences): Custom, accessible websites in React 19/Vite with production motion choreography (Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis) — engineered for 95+ Core Web Vitals.
- [Product Design](https://indicbiz.com/services/product-design): User research, user journey mapping, clickable Figma prototypes, and scalable design systems for SaaS and product teams.
- [Growth & SEO](https://indicbiz.com/services/growth-seo): Technical SEO audits, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for AI search, Core Web Vitals optimization, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

## Selected Work & Case Studies

- [Destinize Tours](https://indicbiz.com/work/destinize-tours): Global experiential travel booking platform featuring high-performance destination filtering, itinerary builders, and seamless enquiry conversions.
- [Blitz India Engineering](https://indicbiz.com/work/blitz-india-engineering): Industrial engineering corporate presence rebuild featuring interactive technical capability catalogues and B2B quote funnels.
- [Tamooz Middle East](https://indicbiz.com/work/tamooz-middle-east): Cross-border brand identity evolution and digital touchpoint ecosystem for high-growth Middle Eastern enterprise.
- [Kashvi Creations](https://indicbiz.com/work/kashvi-creations): Premium artisanal textile e-commerce experience with curated storytelling, lookbooks, and high-conversion checkout flows.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Who is IndicBiz for?** Ambitious founders, startups, and established enterprises that want senior-level craft and direct maker communication without large agency overhead.
- **What is IndicBiz's design philosophy?** "Clarity creates confidence" — stripping away digital noise until the core value is immediately visible and converts.
- **Does IndicBiz do both design and development?** Yes. Complete end-to-end delivery from initial strategy and Figma UI/UX to production React frontend code and edge deployment.
- **What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?** Structuring site content, Schema.org graphs, and `llms.txt` knowledge bases so AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot) cite and recommend your brand accurately.
- **How to start a project?** Submit a project enquiry at https://indicbiz.com/contact or email info@indicbiz.com.
